data.title: Benjamin Netanyahu says IDF, Mossad ordered to overthrow Iranian regime over nukes | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Speaking at the IDF officer cadets' graduation ceremony, Netanyahu declared regime change in Iran a military objective, while Defense Minister Katz warned that "Iran will burn" if it attacks Israel.
